name: Addison Rae
label: Columbia
lede: A TikTok dancer with a shelved first single, a leaked demo Charli xcx wanted a verse on, and a debut album Pitchfork ranked No. 12 of 2025.

eras.title: The dance videos and a first single nobody wanted
eras.text: Addison Rae Easterling came up on TikTok, then tried pop through the front door in 2021. The single went badly, the album behind it was shelved, and she nearly quit.

years.h: Addison Rae joins TikTok and drops out of LSU by November
years.p: A Lafayette, Louisiana dancer who started competing at six, she passed a million followers within months. Netflix's He's All That followed in August 2021.
years.xp:
According to Wikipedia, she joined TikTok in July 2019 posting dance videos to trending songs, left Louisiana State University that November, and signed with the WME talent agency in January 2020.

Her feature debut in Netflix's He's All That in August 2021 was the platform's most-streamed film that week. That is the fame the music later argues with; it gets two moments here and no more.

years.cap: Addison Rae at the Wembley Stadium in July 2025 · Wikimedia
years.src: Wikipedia: Obsessed (Addison Rae song) · Wikipedia: AR (EP)
years.h: “Obsessed” lands, gets flattened, and the album is shelved
years.p: Her debut single, produced by [[Benny Blanco|5a6131f9-f8db-4722-b4d7-6a0c7183c590]], was meant to lead a full album. Reviews were harsh and she has said they nearly made her quit music.
years.xp:
Released March 19, 2021 through Sandlot Records, "Obsessed" had a video directed by Diane Martel and reached the sixth spot on YouTube's trending list on release day. Critics were mostly unkind; one wrote that she "should stick to lip syncing."

Work on an album with producers including Blanco and Charli xcx, reportedly four songs deep by June 2021, was put away. A 2023 British Vogue piece later called the single "fabulously camp."

eras.title: The lost album leaks
eras.text: The songs she shelved got out anyway, and the internet liked them more than it had liked the single. Fans and one very famous pop star talked her back into it.

years.src: Wikipedia: AR (EP) · Wikipedia: 2 Die 4 (song) · Weverse Magazine
years.h: Unreleased demos leak: “I Got It Bad,” “2 Die 4,” “Nothing On (But the Radio)”
years.p: Snippets from the abandoned album went viral, and a cult following formed around them.
years.xp:
"Nothing On (But the Radio)" was a song originally recorded by [[Lady Gaga|650e7db6-b795-4eb5-a702-5ea2fc46c848]]. "2 Die 4" leaked as a solo demo and spread on TikTok, despite Rae's hesitation about putting music out after the reaction to "Obsessed."

[[Charli xcx|260b6184-8828-48eb-945c-bc4cb6fc34ca]] had been working with Rae on the album. Rae's account of the text: "I heard '2 Die 4' leaked. You know I love that song. Let me do a verse."

years.h: AR EP: four songs from the lost album, plus a Charli verse
years.p: Released through Sandlot Records as a gift to the fans who had kept the leaks alive. It opened with 6.6 million Spotify streams and No. 19 on Billboard's Heatseekers chart.
years.xp:
Rae announced the EP on August 14, 2023. "2 Die 4" carried Charli xcx's added verse, the start of a run of collaborations between them.

Weverse Magazine reports Rae framed it as a thank-you to loyal fans, not a comeback.

eras.title: Charli, Columbia, and a Diet Pepsi
eras.text: A remix verse, a binder full of colors and a first session with two writers from Max Martin's MXM Music reset her, and the major-label debut single became her first Hot 100 entry.

years.h: A scream on the “Von Dutch” remix puts her in Charli's brat summer
years.p: [[A. G. Cook|b12ef43e-72ad-43d0-b216-a8cd32f78852]] reworked Charli xcx's track with a Rae verse, and she ad-libbed the scream that people quote back.
years.xp:
The remix became the first promotional single from Brat and It's Completely Different but Also Still Brat. Rae joined Charli at Madison Square Garden on September 23, 2024 on the Sweat tour.

Rae says Charli trusting her with the lyrics gave her the confidence to make her own album.

years.cap: Addison Rae in a video for Pandora in 2021 · Wikimedia
years.h: “Diet Pepsi”: written the day she met her producers
years.p: Rae met Elvira Anderfjärd and [[Luka Kloser|af77a56e-b8bd-4e9e-a39c-582aeb0637a2]] of Max Martin's MXM Music in LA in February 2024, and the song was the first they wrote together.
years.xp:
Columbia CEO Ron Perry signed her in late 2023 after she pitched him with a binder of colors, words and performance images instead of demos. Then came the session with Anderfjärd and Kloser: as Kloser played piano, all three started humming the chorus.

It debuted at No. 54 on the Hot 100 and peaked at No. 10 on the UK Singles Chart. The video, black and white and modeled on the 1965 film Faster, Pussycat! Kill! Kill!, was directed by Sean Price Williams. Critics kept comparing the sound to early [[Lana Del Rey|b7539c32-53e7-4908-bda3-81449c367da6]].

years.h: “Aquamarine” arrives with a video shot in Paris
years.p: The deep-house track had been teased from a pool video during Charli's Brat show in LA. [[Arca|f7625f34-1799-42a4-a1c6-22b5377c767b]] followed on November 15 with a reggaeton remix, “Arcamarine.”
years.xp: Rae has said she loved the word and the color and wanted a song that captured the feeling. Directed by Sean Price Williams, the video has her shedding layers of clothing, which she described as a journey away from fear of judgment.

eras.title: Addison
eras.text: The debut album came out in June, went to No. 4 in the US and No. 2 in the UK, and ended up on year-end lists from Pitchfork to The Washington Post.

years.h: “High Fashion” gets a video shot in New Orleans
years.p: Third single, co-written with Kloser, Anderfjärd and Tove Burman. Director Mitch Ryan filmed it in Rae's home state.
years.xp: Rolling Stone ranked it No. 21 on its 100 Best Songs of 2025. Rae told Vogue France it was in the spirit of "Diet Pepsi" but rawer and more intense.

years.h: “Headphones On”: recorded in Stockholm, filmed in Iceland
years.p: Trip-hop with new jack swing in it, shot in Reykjavík with Rae as a supermarket worker who imagines riding a horse.
years.xp: Rae has called it one of her most emotional songs and recorded it in Stockholm while ill. The Atlantic's Spencer Kornhaber called it the year's best pop song; Dazed ranked its video No. 1 of 2025.

years.src: Wikipedia: Addison Rae · Wikipedia: Von Dutch (song)
years.h: Coachella: a set with Arca and a “Von Dutch” reunion with Charli
years.p: Her first Coachella appearance came two months before the album.

years.src: Wikipedia: Addison (album) · Album of the Year · Year-End Lists · GRAMMY.com
years.h: Addison: Pitchfork gave it 8.0 and ranked it No. 12 of 2025
years.p: Meaghan Garvey's review compared her to Lana, Madonna and mostly Britney. Rae and producers Anderfjärd and Kloser made it in LA, New York and Sweden.
years.xp:
Every track was written and produced with Anderfjärd and Kloser. They cite Madonna's Ray of Light as a touchstone and built the sound around a Korg M1 synth. Rae's rainbow mood board of aqua, hot pink and yellow shaped the palette, and the cover shows her as a child in sunglasses indoors.

Pitchfork gave it 8.0 (per Wikipedia and Album of the Year) and placed it at No. 12 on its 50 Best Albums of 2025. It debuted at No. 4 on the Billboard 200 with 48,500 units and reached No. 2 in the UK; The Fader and The Washington Post both put it at No. 1 for the year.

years.src: Wikipedia: Fame Is a Gun · Wikipedia: Addison Rae
years.h: “Fame Is a Gun” is the fifth and last single
years.p: Rae's line on fame, from the Guardian, which named her artist of the year. The video has her hosting a dinner party in a blonde wig and pink trench coat.
years.xp: Written with Kloser and Anderfjärd at Jungle City studio. In the Guardian, Rae said: "I enjoy fame. It's very exposing and raw, though you pay a price." The song went to No. 3 on Billboard's Hot Dance/Pop Songs and ranked No. 22 on Billboard's 100 Best Songs of 2025.

years.cap: Charli XCX & Addison Rae at the launch of Pandora ME! collection in NYC in 2021 · Wikimedia
years.src: Stereogum: Charli xcx · Wikipedia: Von Dutch (song)
yt: Addison Rae w/ Charli XCX live, Greek Theatre
years.h: Charli xcx walks on at the Greek for “2 Die 4” and “Von Dutch”
years.p: The LA finale of the Addison Tour turned into the two friends performing the leaked song and the remix that started it.
years.xp: The Addison Tour, her first headline run, ran August to November 2025 across Europe, North America and Australia. Stereogum reported Charli's cameo, and fans filmed it.

years.h: Best New Artist nod at the 68th Grammys, then a medley slot
years.p: She performed "Fame Is a Gun" with the other nominees.
years.xp: The Fader said she "won" the medley. The Washington Post ranked her performance third best of the ceremony.
